article_content: In William Boyd's new Bond novel 'Solo', showcased at a launch in London, James Bond is 45 years old in 1969 and still going through 70 cigarettes a day. Despite his vices, Boyd's version hints at a spy who craves something more meaningful than casual encounters. Bond also trades his classic single boiled egg for scrambled eggs and bacon at breakfast. The story takes him from a civil war in West Africa all the way to America, keeping the glamour and danger fans expect. While Daniel Craig has embodied Bond on screen recently, Boyd insists his look doesn't align with Ian Fleming's original design, suggesting Daniel Day-Lewis as a better fit. Even so, Lucy Fleming, Ian Fleming's niece, was on hand at the Dorchester hotel launch and gave her seal of approval for this fresh perspective on the famous agent.

Apesar de seus vícios, a versão de Boyd sugere um espião que busca algo mais significativo do que encontros casuais. Bond também deixa de lado seu clássico ovo cozido único e passa a saborear ovos mexidos com bacon no café da manhã. A história o leva de uma guerra civil na África Ocidental até os Estados Unidos, preservando o glamour e o perigo que os fãs esperam. Embora Daniel Craig tenha interpretado Bond recentemente no cinema, Boyd insiste que sua aparência não combina com a descrição original de Ian Fleming, apontando Daniel Day-Lewis como mais adequado. Mesmo assim, Lucy Fleming, sobrinha de Ian Fleming, participou do lançamento no hotel Dorchester e aprovou esta nova perspectiva sobre o famoso agente.

article_content: 'This is the unusual moment when a man sets up a portable gas stove and performs a cooking demonstration on a commuter train.' 'In the video, the amateur chef cooks with a frying pan on top of stacked-up milk crates covered by a red and white checked tablecloth along the Frankston railway line in Melbourne.' 'He cuts pieces of food with scissors and stirs them with a wooden spoon, while amused passengers watch and laugh in the background.' 'Addressing a new passenger, he jokes about having a meal ready in a few minutes, calling her a lucky lady.' 'He demonstrates how to add mozzarella sticks to the dish, playfully counting them before stirring everything together.' 'While waiting for the cheese to melt, he casually does pull-ups near the train door as onlookers cheer him on.' 'He then returns to the stove to stir the pan, adjusting the heat and reassuring the crowd that everything is under control.' 'The video ends with the impression that the audience is about to enjoy a unique treat, having garnered more than 300,000 views on Facebook since being posted on Sunday by BJ Gallagher.'

'No vídeo, o cozinheiro amador prepara comida em uma frigideira colocada sobre engradados de leite empilhados cobertos por uma toalha xadrez vermelha e branca na linha ferroviária de Frankston, em Melbourne.' 'Ele corta pedaços de comida com uma tesoura e mexe com uma colher de pau, enquanto passageiros se divertem e riem ao fundo.' 'Falando com uma nova passageira, ele brinca que terá uma refeição pronta em alguns minutos, chamando-a de sortuda.' 'Ele demonstra como adicionar palitos de mussarela ao prato, contando-os de forma divertida antes de mexer tudo junto.' 'Enquanto espera o queijo derreter, ele faz barras nas proximidades da porta do trem, aplaudido pelos espectadores.' 'Depois disso, ele volta para o fogão para mexer a panela, ajustando o calor e tranquilizando o público de que tudo está sob controle.' 'O vídeo termina com a impressão de que a plateia está prestes a aproveitar algo único, pois obteve mais de 300.000 visualizações no Facebook desde que foi postado no domingo por BJ Gallagher.'

article_content: 'Authorities in Florida announced Monday the arrest of a man in Colorado, believed to be the author of a controversial book described as a how-to guide for pedophiles.' 'Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd emphasized that individuals cannot involve or depict children in exploitative contexts, referring to a Florida obscenity statute used to charge the suspect, Phillip Greaves, with distributing material involving minors in harmful conduct.' 'Greaves, who self-published the book titled The Pedophile's Guide to Love and Pleasure: A Child-Lover's Code of Conduct, was arrested in Pueblo, Colorado, based on a Florida felony warrant after investigators received a copy of the book by mail.' 'He now faces extradition to Florida. According to Sheriff Judd, Greaves even autographed the copy he sent out, which he claimed was his last.' 'The book gained national attention when Amazon.com initially defended selling it, drawing numerous threats of boycotts. Ultimately, Amazon removed the title in early November.' 'Sheriff Judd expressed shock at its contents, which allegedly provided detailed instructions for sexual exploitation of minors and included examples featuring children as young as nine and thirteen.' 'Despite Greaves’ claim to First Amendment protection, Judd insisted that Florida law could still hold him accountable.' 'The book is said to discuss grooming strategies, preparing minors for sexual acts, and coaching them on deceiving parents, outlining a so-called ‘code of ethics’ for pedophiles.' 'Judd reiterated that distributing such content to anyone within their jurisdiction is a prosecutable offense, stressing the priority of safeguarding children.'

'Greaves, que publicou por conta própria o livro intitulado The Pedophile's Guide to Love and Pleasure: A Child-Lover's Code of Conduct, foi preso em Pueblo, no Colorado, com base em um mandado de crime emitido na Flórida depois que investigadores receberam uma cópia do livro pelo correio.' 'Agora, ele enfrenta extradição para a Flórida. Segundo o xerife Judd, Greaves chegou a autografar o exemplar que enviou, o qual teria sido o último em seu poder.' 'O livro ganhou atenção nacional quando a Amazon.com inicialmente defendeu sua venda, provocando várias ameaças de boicote. Por fim, a Amazon removeu o título no início de novembro.' 'O xerife Judd se mostrou chocado com o conteúdo, que supostamente oferecia instruções detalhadas sobre a exploração sexual de menores, incluindo exemplos que envolviam crianças de nove e treze anos.' 'Apesar da alegação de Greaves de proteção pela Primeira Emenda, Judd insistiu que a lei da Flórida ainda poderia responsabilizá-lo.' It was likely not the best moment for Nigel Farage to address Ukip's difficulty attracting female voters. Standing on a Chieftain Mk10 tank at the Heywood Tank Museum, after three pints of beer, he acknowledged the party's 'blokeish' image could put women off. He then quipped, 'What do you want me to do? Go sell flowers?'

Farage was campaigning in Heywood and Middleton for the by-election triggered by the death of Labour MP Jim Dobbin. Ukip candidate John Bickley hopes to overturn Labour's nearly 6,000-vote majority. A poll suggested that if only men voted, Ukip would win, with 41% of men favoring Ukip compared to 38% for Labour. Among women, however, only 21% support Ukip, while 58% favor Labour.

Ukip has been accused of sexism, notably after one of its MEPs referred to female activists as 'sluts.' Farage initially denied that his party had a 'women problem,' but conceded its former 'rugby club' atmosphere. He also insisted there had been a 'sea change' in 2014, with a rise in female candidates and prominent female figures.

During the campaigning, Farage made his customary stop at a local pub, The Gardeners Arms, highlighting his approachable image. Ukip has stepped up attacks on Labour, aiming to show it can attract votes from both major parties. Meanwhile, Ukip is predicted to win the Clacton by-election, prompted by Douglas Carswell's defection from the Conservatives. London Mayor Boris Johnson added to Conservative woes by forgetting the name of their candidate, Giles Watling. Finally, Farage was re-elected unopposed as Ukip leader for another four years, setting up the possibility that the party could have an MP (Carswell) in Parliament while its leader remains outside the Commons if Farage fails to secure a seat next May.

O Ukip intensificou os ataques ao Partido Trabalhista, buscando mostrar que pode conquistar votos de ambos os grandes partidos. O prefeito de Londres, Boris Johnson, contribuiu para as preocupações dos conservadores ao esquecer o nome do candidato da legenda, Giles Watling. Por fim, Farage foi reeleito sem oposição como líder do Ukip por mais quatro anos, criando a possibilidade de o partido ter um deputado (Carswell) no Parlamento enquanto seu líder permanece fora da Câmara dos Comuns, caso Farage não consiga uma cadeira em maio do ano que vem.

article_content: '(CNN) -- The Coast Guard announced on Tuesday that it, along with other agencies, halted the search for three children whose mother allegedly threw them into the Delaware River overnight. Delaware River Port Authority officials indicated there is no evidence supporting the woman's claim, as reported by the Cherry Hill Courier-Post. They noted the bridge has constant surveillance, and no suspicious activity was detected during the stated timeframe.' 'The search was suspended at 12:25 p.m. after more than eight hours, covering 10 square miles, according to the Coast Guard. Several agencies, including the Coast Guard Station Philadelphia, Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City, Camden Police and Fire Departments, Delaware River Port Authority, New Jersey State Police, Philadelphia Fire and Rescue, and Philadelphia Marine Police, participated. They focused on the Delaware River near the Benjamin Franklin Bridge, which connects Camden, New Jersey, and Philadelphia.' 'A nurse at St. Joseph's Hospital in Philadelphia claimed the woman, who identified herself as having given birth around 3:35 a.m., reported throwing her newborn, as well as her 2-year-old and 4-year-old children, off a bridge into the river. The bridge's walkways are reportedly closed overnight, making the woman's account less plausible, according to Delaware River Port Authority spokesman Ed Kasuba. He suggested that any attempt to stop a car on the bridge would have been noticed.' 'The woman, identified by the Coast Guard as Michelle “Shelly” Perez, remains missing, and authorities have not confirmed the existence or safety of her children.'

Autoridades da Delaware River Port Authority informaram que não há evidências que corroborem a alegação da mulher, conforme relatado pelo jornal Cherry Hill Courier-Post. Elas destacaram que a ponte é monitorada constantemente e nenhuma atividade suspeita foi detectada no período em questão.' 'As buscas foram suspensas às 12h25, após mais de oito horas e o rastreamento de uma área de 10 milhas quadradas, segundo a Guarda Costeira. Diversas agências, incluindo a Guarda Costeira da Estação da Filadélfia, a Guarda Costeira da Estação Aérea de Atlantic City, a Polícia e o Corpo de Bombeiros de Camden, a Delaware River Port Authority, a Polícia Estadual de Nova Jersey, o Corpo de Bombeiros e Resgate da Filadélfia e a Polícia Marítima da Filadélfia, participaram. As equipes se concentraram no Rio Delaware perto da Ponte Benjamin Franklin, que liga Camden, em Nova Jersey, à Filadélfia.' 'Uma enfermeira do Hospital St. Joseph, na Filadélfia, relatou que a mulher, que afirmou ter dado à luz por volta das 3h35, disse ter jogado seu recém-nascido, bem como suas crianças de 2 e 4 anos, de uma ponte no rio. As passarelas da ponte estariam fechadas durante a noite, o que, segundo o porta-voz da Delaware River Port Authority, Ed Kasuba, torna esse relato menos provável. Ele ressaltou que qualquer parada de carro na ponte teria sido notada.' 'A mulher, identificada pela Guarda Costeira como Michelle “Shelly” Perez, segue desaparecida. As autoridades ainda não confirmaram a existência ou a segurança de seus filhos.'

article_content: 'Morgan Stanley and BNP Paribas have updated their recommendations on several companies, including Indiabulls Housing, Grasim, Ashok Leyland, and M&M. Morgan Stanley maintains a Buy rating on Indiabulls Housing with a target price of Rs 103. The Q2 results for Indiabulls Housing were in line with estimates, with a significant PPOP beat attributed to higher assignment income and lower operating costs. Despite higher credit costs and a higher effective tax rate, net profit remained in line.' 'Meanwhile, Morgan Stanley also retains an Overweight rating on Grasim Industries with a target price of Rs 1985. The Q2 standalone EBITDA fell below estimates, primarily impacted by a weaker performance in the chemicals business, partially balanced by the viscose segment. The paint business launch remains on track, and the B2B e-commerce unit is expanding.' 'BNP Paribas issued a Buy rating on Ashok Leyland with a target of Rs 220, underpinned by stable demand in the second half of the year, largely driven by government infrastructure projects, industrial activity, and agricultural growth. The company maintains its FY24 volume growth target of 8-10% for MHCV and 4-5% for LCV. BNP Paribas also retains a Buy rating on M&M, setting a target of Rs 1905, noting that both automotive and FES revenue generally met or exceeded expectations despite some margin pressures.' 'Additional economic news highlights a likely 6.7% GDP growth in India’s July-September quarter, reinforced by the services sector. Telecom providers have voiced concerns over the proposal to directly stream TV content to mobile phones without cellular data, pointing to technological constraints. Furthermore, the government is considering increasing the threshold for GST evasion decriminalization from Rs 2 crore to Rs 3 crore, aiming to reduce unwarranted harassment and bolster the ease of doing business.' 'Disclaimer: Views shared are those of the individual brokerages. They do not represent official standpoints of the Economic Times. Readers are advised to consult financial experts before making any investment decisions.'
